held_by: Changning District Planning and Natural Resources Bureau. Numerical observations only.
date_note: The article was published on 2025-05-26. The archival street elevation bears the district maternal and child health hospital name. Its exposure date is unknown.
conditional_scale: Assumed 3.2 to 3.6 m from floor to floor in this first study. Re-estimate using georeferenced street cameras. Only the near side of the projecting stair hall is visible in the agency photo.

ascending_sashes_bottom_to_top.note: Overhang obscures the top of the two higher lights.

evidence_scope: Four full rises with three individual lights visible at each stair landing, a partly visible fifth group at the plinth, the round ground-floor window, a projecting concrete eyebrow, two parapet bands and a short side return.
